aiDescriptions.n: The docs show no generator for schema or column descriptions. KG Builder (Labs) suggests a schema from pasted text only.

bulkMetadata.n: The docs show no native schema comment or tag store. Users edit Aura Agent tool descriptions in a low-code UI.

autoClassify.n: The docs show no automatic classification of properties.

sampleValues.n: No native feature exists. The langchain-neo4j package can scan the database for example values (enhanced_schema, default off).

queryHistory.n: The docs show no query-history mining for schema, examples or suggestions.

lineage.n: Neo4j has no lineage feature. Neo4j pages show lineage as a graph modeling pattern. Customers and partners build it.

evals.n: Aura Agent evaluations use datasets of up to 50 questions and five metrics. The docs show no preview label. The start date is unknown.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Neo4j has no table or column comment object. So no bulk description statement exists. Put business meaning in Aura Agent tool descriptions. Also put it in few-shot examples for Text2CypherRetriever. Build an Aura Agent evaluation dataset with expected answers. Use it to test changes.

bulkSnippet.code:
# Few-shot examples for Text2CypherRetriever (not a schema comment; Neo4j has none)
examples = [
  "USER INPUT: 'Which actors starred in the Matrix?' "
  "QUERY: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.title = 'The Matrix' RETURN p.name"
]
retriever = Text2CypherRetriever(driver=driver, llm=llm,
  neo4j_schema=neo4j_schema, examples=examples)

aiDescriptions.n: Voicebox in Designer drafts classes, relationships and mappings. The docs do not describe AI-written descriptions. Bulk description edits are manual.

bulkMetadata.n: Descriptions are rdfs:comment triples. Load Turtle with stardog data add. Or upload a data model as Turtle in Designer.

autoClassify.n: The docs show no automatic classification of columns or entities.

sampleValues.n: Voicebox finds entities in questions by full-text search on labels. The stardog:label property can match fuzzily. No sample-value feature exists.

queryHistory.n: Voicebox Reporting exports queries and feedback for manual review. The docs show no automatic suggestion of joins, metrics or examples.

lineage.n: Voicebox lineage traces the data behind each answer. The docs show no column-level catalog lineage.

evals.n: Thumbs up and down feedback and exportable reporting exist. Users add stored queries by hand. The docs show no benchmark runner.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write rdfs:label and rdfs:comment on classes and properties. Voicebox reads them. Load them in bulk with stardog data add and a Turtle file. Add 5 to 50 stored queries as few-shot examples. Give each query a system:voiceboxQuestion field.

bulkSnippet.code:
# descriptions.ttl holds rdfs:label and rdfs:comment triples for classes and properties
stardog data add --format turtle myDatabase descriptions.ttl

For scripted writes, call PATCH /v0/metadata/resources/bulk/{owner}. It updates up to 25 resources per call. Archie needs an Enterprise plan. Activate it through your Customer Success Director.

notes.topic: Neo4j LLM Knowledge Graph Builder (lead: schema and descriptions from documents)
notes.text: Partly confirmed. It is a Neo4j Labs project. It uses Apache-2.0 and is not in the supported product lineup. It extracts an entity graph from documents with LLMs. Its 'Get Schema From Text' option suggests a schema from pasted text, RDF ontologies or a Cypher/GQL schema. The pages describe no description generation. The pages describe no evaluation.

Confirmed as an experimental Labs repo. It has datasets, evaluation notebooks and fine-tuning notebooks. The folders are functional_cypher and synthetic_*_demodbs. The Hugging Face dataset neo4j/text2cypher-2025v1 is Apache-2.0 with 10K to 100K rows. Its card gives no source or intended use. These are datasets and notebooks. They are not an eval service.

Refuted as a product feature. The use-case index has no lineage or catalog page. The Metadata Management page mentions lineage only in customer and partner videos (University of Washington, Adaptive). The videos show lineage as a modeling pattern.

Neo4j announced Aura Agent as generally available on 2026-02-03. It has Cypher Template, Similarity Search and Text2Cypher tools. It also has a REST endpoint and a read-only MCP server. The docs describe agent evaluations with datasets of up to 50 questions and five metrics. The docs show no preview label. The GA blog does not mention evaluations.

notes.topic: Stardog Voicebox generating mappings and descriptions (lead)
notes.text: Partly confirmed. Voicebox for Designer needs a Voicebox-enabled endpoint. It lists 'Automated Ontology Generation', which maps data sources to ontology concepts with human review. The docs do not describe AI-written descriptions. The Designer bulk description edit is manual. The dev guide says Voicebox API access is limited.

sources.t: Voicebox: Ontology Maintenance and Data Mapping

notes.text: Refined. 'virtual add' registers a mapping file. 'virtual import' copies mapped data into Stardog. Neither command imports mapping files as metadata. Relational sources with a built-in schema get automatic R2RML direct mapping. SMS2 is the recommended syntax. The release notes say Stardog removed SMS1 support in 11.0.0 (2025-01-22). The virtual graphs page still names SMS as the default.

Partly confirmed, through coding agents. It is not an in-product generator. The 12 RelationalAI Agent Skills include rai-ontology. It builds ontologies from Snowflake tables or local data. The tutorial tells you to review the generated files in model/. The docs home calls the product a 'decision intelligence platform'. RAI_QUERY_MODEL is Preview. Cortex agent deployment is early access.

sources.t: Go further with a coding agent (tutorial)

notes.topic: data.world ownership and AI Context Engine (lead)
notes.text: The data.world home page shows the banner 'data.world is now part of ServiceNow!' with no date. The name 'AI Context Engine' appears on no data.world page or doc, so it is Unverified. The docs name the AI assistant Archie.

Confirmed as Archie Enrich, in Public Preview for Enterprise customers. It drafts descriptions for tables, columns, glossary terms and collections. It marks output '[Archie suggestion]'. In bulk mode it generates up to 50 descriptions at once. SQL generation and research-question generation are beta. The FAQ says the vendor does not use customer data to train the model.

sources.t: Enriching catalog resources in bulk using Archie

notes.text: Confirmed. PATCH /v0/metadata/resources/bulk/{owner} updates up to 25 resources per call. The bulk create endpoint has the same limit. The reference lists no rate limits. The MCP server can edit descriptions, tags and custom properties. Excel bulk upload exists in the Catalog Toolkit.

sources.t: data.world MCP server for AI assistants

notes.text: Partly confirmed. The system collects lineage automatically from supported systems through collectors. Users can add manual relationships. The docs do not say if lineage is column-level. So the lineage level is 0 under the column-level definition.

Partly confirmed. AI FDE has an Ontology editing mode for 'creating or updating the objects, links, and actions'. It needs AIP enabled. It recommends Global Branching. The docs show no beta or GA label. The docs do not name object types or descriptions.

Confirmed. AIP Evals tests AIP Logic, AIP Chatbot and code-authored functions. It uses built-in, LLM-as-judge or custom evaluators. Test cases come from manual entry or Ontology object sets. A 'Generate evals' button exists for eligible Logic functions. The docs show no status label. AIP Chatbot Studio is the new name of AIP Agent Studio.

sources.t: AIP Evals: create an evaluation suite

notes.text: Partly confirmed. Data Lineage is a dataset graph with ancestors and descendants. Its column feature only finds datasets that share a column name. Workflow Lineage adds property provenance across Ontology objects, functions, actions and apps. The docs show no column-level lineage.
